planets.name: HD 219134 b
planets.description: HD 219134 b crosses its star every 3.09 days and is 1.6 times as wide as Earth, found in 2015.

text.card: HD 219134 b was found in 2015 by Roque de los Muchachos Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 6 planets known around HD 219134. Its orbit and size follow Gillon et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
